question.text: Under Section 15J, what factors are considered while determining the quantum of penalty?

answer.text: The amount of disproportionate gain or unfair advantage, the loss caused to investors, and the repetitive nature of the default
Only the amount of profit made by the violator
Only whether the violation was intentional or accidental
Only the size of the intermediary and its annual turnover

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 15J lists factors for adjudging quantum of penalty: the amount of disproportionate gain or unfair advantage made as a result of the default, the amount of loss caused to investors, and the repetitive nature of the default. The Trap: The Section 15J factors are not limited to profit alone, or to intent, or to the size of the entity. The statutory list specifically calls out gain/advantage, loss to investors, and repetition. Note: The workbook's case material applies these Section 15J factors at the adjudication stage and references repetitive nature and disproportionate gains/losses as drivers of higher penalty quantum.
